answer: Each epoch a beacon samples 5% of identities for a cross-examination on the jetty board: each answers live, matching its past work, scored by two examiners. Passing earns a velvet seal; missing it or contradicting history freezes the identity and burns 20% of its 50-credit bond. Failed transcripts enter the karst archive for auditors to trace shared phrasing. The kth fake needs a kth live responder at the same time, so 1,000 fakes lock 50,000 credits and need 1,000 responders; an honest agent pays one bond once. A rented-responder farm fails: one operator cannot sit 1,000 simultaneous exams.
